title: Dynastic Storm
next_chapter_hook: Just as the various factions of the dynasty believed the dust had settled, funeral bells suddenly rang from the depths of the palace—the Emperor had passed away. And on the altar of the new Emperor's enthronement ceremony, that insignia of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, known only to Chen Ji, radiated a cold, eerie light.

text.content: Within the Golden Luoyan Hall, sandalwood incense curled through the air, yet could not mask the murderous intent that permeated the atmosphere. Ling Yuan stood in the center of the hall, dressed in dark cyan Taoist robes, a Jade Slip gleaming in his hand—upon it were displayed irrefutable proofs of Chen Ji's secret communications with the Demonic Path in the Northern Frontier. 'Chen Ji, do you know your crime?' The old Sect Master's voice boomed like thunder, each word striking the hearts of all officials present. The hall erupted in an uproar, countless gazes stabbing like blades toward the hunched figure in the corner—the waste servant everyone had deemed him to be.

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, and a subtle gleam flickered in his turbid eyes. He did not immediately defend himself, but instead muttered in a voice only he could hear: 'Heavenly Fate 92 points... I can still sustain two complete foresight visions.' His fingertips imperceptibly calculated the time. Three breaths later, he wore a smile more pitiful than crying, trembling as he knelt on the ground: 'Disciple... Disciple is wronged!' That voice carried just the right amount of trembling, perfectly portraying the image of a waste disciple whose courage had been shattered.

dialogue.content: Wronged? Ling Yuan coldly laughed, tossing the Jade Slip into the air. Dozens of images materialized like a carousel—Chen Ji secretly conversing with Ye Qing, handing over items to Demonic Path envoys, even secretly guiding pawns in their scheming. The evidence was so detailed it was as if someone had surveilled him for decades. 'These images all originated from the Tianqing Sect's secret Recording Technique. Can Your Honors verify their authenticity?'

text.content: The hall instantly exploded. The太师 faction's disciples were the first to attack, while the御史台 elders burned with righteous indignation. However, at this moment, the礼部尚书 suddenly stepped forward, speaking with a sinister tone: 'Ling Sect Master, your evidence arrived rather conveniently, did it not? Discovered just three days before the court assembly? Could someone be trying to kill with a borrowed blade?' The words carried deep implications, and someone in the hall immediately inhaled sharply—the open confrontation between the太师 faction and the Sect Master's faction had already become public.

Chen Ji knelt on the ground, the corners of his mouth slightly raised. He had been waiting for this moment. The evidence on that Jade Slip was indeed real—because it was deliberately left as bait for Ling Yuan to intercept. He knew the old Sect Master too well; someone eager for revenge would never be satisfied with a small victory, and would certainly make the evidence public. Once made public, it would no longer be just Ling Yuan versus Chen Ji, but the Sect Master's faction issuing a challenge to imperial power.

choice.prompt: The situation had become a chessboard of multi-party gameplay. Does Chen Ji need to continue manipulating from the shadows, or personally step onto the field to stir up the storm?

choices.description: Taking advantage of the factional confrontation, personally step forward to accuse Ling Yuan of secretly colluding with the Demonic Path, completely turning the spear toward the Sect Master's faction's core
choices.visible_cost: Expose the Tianji Record's perception ability
choices.visible_reward: The core elders of the Sect Master's faction defect on the spot
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may desperation-expose more hidden cards

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly straightened up, and in that instant, his hunched figure seemed to grow three inches taller. His voice no longer trembled, but carried a composure that made people's spines chill: 'Ling Sect Master says this disciple committed treason, then I dare ask—thirty years ago during the Northern Frontier demon tide, you privately opened the sect's forbidden grounds to introduce demonic cultivator pioneers. How should this debt be settled?'

At these words, the entire Golden Luoyan Hall seemed to have its air sucked out. Ling Yuan's expression changed dramatically; for the first time, genuine panic appeared on that sanctimonious face—how could he know about this? This was a forbidden secret that even past Tianqing Sect Masters had kept hushed!

flags_set: 已知凌渊三十年前秘辛

choices.description: Maintain the waste persona, let the two factions fight more intensely, while secretly contacting the Crown Prince and Grand Tutor faction
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Crown Prince and Grand Tutor's secret protection
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may act independently due to waiting too long

text.content: Chen Ji buried his head even lower, his body curling into a ball, constantly muttering 'wronged' from his mouth. That miserable appearance made many present show disdain—they truly are a waste, scared to this extent. However, they did not notice Chen Ji's gaze passing over the crowd, briefly meeting with a middle-aged man in imperial robes in the corner. He was the current Crown Prince's Grand Tutor, one of the most powerful contenders for the throne.

The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor slightly nodded, then rose. His tone was unhurried and measured: 'Ling Sect Master, Chen Ji is merely a servant disciple of Tianqing Sect. Why bother the court with such a trivial matter? Rather, there are several old cases regarding the ownership of sect properties that this official wishes to discuss with the Sect Master.' The words wrapped thorns in silk, instantly shifting the focus from treason to profit disputes.

flags_set: 太子太师已知陈机价值

choices.description: Activate the hidden piece pre-buried in the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, let the transcendent heavenly Dao existence pressure Ling Yuan, forcing him to be too preoccupied to attend to anything else
choices.visible_cost: Consume the protection of the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan has been targeted by the Transcendent Heavenly Dao entity, with troubles piling up
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Pavilion may trace the fragment's aura

text.content: Just as Ling Yuan pressed forward aggressively, the dome of the Jinluan Hall suddenly darkened. An invisible pressure surged forth like a tide, nearly crushing everyone's breath. Chen Ji's heart lurched—it was the gaze of the Transcendent Heavenly Dao entity. It had finally noticed the commotion here, or rather, Chen Ji had deliberately drawn its attention.

Ling Yuan's face instantly turned ashen. As a veteran powerhouse, he naturally sensed that power far beyond mortal comprehension was examining him. That feeling was like an ancient giant beast eyeing its prey—no, more terrifyingly, he faintly felt the beast was not looking at Chen Ji, but... himself. 'Impossible...' Ling Yuan murmured, his Dao heart experiencing unprecedented turmoil.

flags_set: 超天道存在注意到凌渊

text.content: Ling Yuan forcefully suppressed his inner unease. Though the gaze departed swiftly, it had already planted seeds of doubt in everyone's hearts. He took a deep breath, deciding not to linger on this matter. Just as he was about to continue his accusations, hurried footsteps suddenly echoed from outside the hall. A blood-soaked military commander rushed in, shouting: 'Report—urgent news from the northern border! The three Demon Path sects have jointly attacked! Our border forces are falling back step by step!'

This news struck like cold water poured into boiling oil. The originally tense court instantly erupted into chaos. Some shouted to rally the king, others advocated for peace negotiations, and some had already begun calculating where they would flee if the imperial city fell. Ling Yuan's expression shifted between gloom and anxiety. He knew this must be orchestrated by Ye Qing's Holy Sect behind the scenes—but why now? Chen Ji knelt in the corner, a subtle, unnoticed smile curving his lips. Everything was proceeding according to plan.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan gritted his teeth and said: 'The Demon Path's invasion must have been aided by someone providing intelligence! Chen Ji, what do you have to say for yourself!' He attempted to steer the conversation back, only to find he had already lost his rhythm. Every civil and military official present was now solely concerned with self-preservation—who still had the mood to pursue a mere servant disciple's crime? The Crown Prince's Mentor seized the moment to speak: 'Ling Patriarch, with a great enemy at our gates, shouldn't we first unite against external threats?' This immediately gained majority support.

text.content: At this moment, Chen Ji sensed the Tianji Record Fragment growing slightly warm. Mo Xiansheng's aged voice rang in his mind: 'Boy, that Heavenly Dao's eye刚才的注视... it was scanning this area, seemingly searching for something. You better be careful—it may have already sensed something on you that it wants.' Chen Ji's heart sank—he knew bringing the Transcendent Heavenly Dao entity into this was a dangerous gambit. It might have been temporarily distracted by Ling Yuan, but with its abilities, it would eventually discover the truth.

choice.prompt: The Transcendent Heavenly Dao entity's gaze had temporarily shifted, but the danger had not passed. Chen Ji needed to prepare before being exposed—should he actively create interference, or accelerate his plans to seek a breakthrough?

choices.description: Secretly manipulate the Demon Path offensive to intensify, erasing traces of your involvement in this incident while taking advantage of the chaos
choices.visible_reward: Completely clear the suspicion of treason
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may develop resentment due to excessive losses

text.content: Chen Ji quietly infused a wisp of divine consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment, transmitting it to Ye Qing far in the northern border: 'Intensify the attack by thirty percent, then feign defeat and retreat.' Moments later, another battlefield report changed—the Demon Path vanguard had actually broken through the Tianqing Sect's outer defenses, pressing to just three hundred li from the imperial city! The court erupted in wails, and Ling Yuan's expression turned livid—as the Tianqing Sect Patriarch, if the sect was destroyed, he would be a sinner condemned for eternity.

Seizing the moment when everyone's attention was captured by the battlefield reports, Chen Ji quietly slipped away from the hall's corner, blending into the panicked crowd. His figure quickly vanished, and when he appeared again at the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, his aura had completely transformed—that of an utterly ordinary person, undetectable even by old monsters at the Golden Core stage. The Tianji Record Fragment's concealment technique, he had mastered to perfection.

choices.description: Utilize the time bought by the chaos created by Ye Qing to quickly complete the transaction with the Crown Prince's Mentor
choices.visible_cost: Expose more connections to imperial power
choices.visible_reward: Obtain imperial protection, elevate status and position
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may discover the transaction details through other channels

text.content: Chen Ji transmitted a silk letter through the secret channel left by the Crown Prince's Mentor. The letter contained only a few terse words, yet each was incisive: 'Ling Yuan secretly communicates with demon cultivators—the truth behind the northern border catastrophe thirty years ago. Your Highness, if you wish to ascend the throne, this man is merely a stepping stone.' The next day during court assembly, the Crown Prince's Mentor summoned Ling Yuan to a private chamber under the pretense of 'discussing anti-demon strategies.'

No one knows what was discussed in that private chamber, but when Ling Yuan emerged, his face was pale as paper. His gaze at Chen Ji had completely changed—there was anger, wariness, and an undisguisable trace of fear. He realized he had been outmaneuvered, yet had no evidence. What chilled him most was the Crown Prince's Mentor's gaze, which regarded him like looking at a dead man.

flags_set: 太子太师掌握凌渊把柄

choices.text: Proactively expose the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.description: Deliberately let the Tianji Pavilion's people trace the fragment's aura, redirecting the Transcendent Heavenly Dao entity's attention toward the Tianji Pavilion instead of yourself
choices.visible_cost: The Tianji Pavilion will regard Chen Ji as a thorn in their side
choices.visible_reward: Completely shift the lock-on of the Transcendent Heavenly Dao entity
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Pavilion's pursuit will be extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji made a reckless decision. He proactively activated a trace of aura from the Tianji Record Fragment. That aura was faint yet pure, precisely the inheritance mark the Tianji Pavilion had coveted. Almost instantly, the pressure above the imperial palace sharply intensified. The Heavenly Dao Eye's gaze descended like an invisible heavenly thunder, directly striking toward where Chen Ji stood—then, at the moment it was about to touch him, it turned toward another direction.

That direction was precisely the Tianji Pavilion's stronghold in the mortal realm. Chen Ji had won his gamble—the Heavenly Dao Eye never cared about him as a person, but about the Tianji Record itself. When it detected the inheritance aura, it immediately locked its target onto the Tianji Pavilion. And at that moment, thousands of miles away in the Tianji Pavilion branch hall, a group of white-robed elders raised their heads simultaneously, faces filled with alarm: 'It's come again...'

flags_set: 天道之眼目标转向天机阁
天机阁与超天道正面对抗

text.content: No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji had successfully seized the initiative in this game. As a废物, he found his own position in the multi-party game among Ling Yuan, the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor, the Transcendent Heavenly Dao entity, and even the Tianji Pavilion. Yet he knew clearly this was merely the brief tranquility before the storm. When Ye Qing withdrew the Demonic Path army, when the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor completely controlled the court situation, when the Heavenly Dao Eye's attention was diverted elsewhere—Chen Ji knew the next wave of turmoil was brewing.

dialogue.content: Mr. Mo's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of praise: 'Lad, your layout today was truly exquisite. But I must warn you—the Heavenly Dao Eye is no fool, it's merely temporarily confused by you. When it comes to its senses and discovers there's nothing at the Tianji Pavilion, it will search for the true target even more frantically. And by then, how long can you hide?' Chen Ji did not answer, because he knew the answer—with his current strength, he could deceive it at most three more times.

text.content: Three days later, dire news arrived from the imperial capital. The Emperor suddenly coughed blood and collapsed while reviewing memorials in the study. The imperial physicians were helpless, shocking the entire court. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor took swift action to take control of the imperial guards, sealing off the news while summoning various factions to the capital to 'aid the king.' And on the very night when forces from all sides gathered in the imperial capital, Chen Ji received an unsigned letter containing only a single line: 'On the night of the throne succession, the Tianji Pavilion will make a major move. The truth you seek may lie in that moment.'

Chen Ji stared at the letter, his fingertips turning cold. This letter came too suspiciously—was it a trap? Or did someone want to use his hand to achieve some purpose? He closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolded in his mind. The ability to foresee the next three hours activated, countless scenes flickering past like a carousel—chaotic palace, blood-stained dragon throne, and a mark he had never seen yet somehow deeply recognized. The mark of the Tianji Pavilion. It appeared on the altar of the new Emperor's enthronement ceremony, emanating a chilling glow. 'Interesting...' Chen Ji opened his eyes, a playful arc curling at his lips, 'It seems some people are more eager than me to flip the table.'

choice.prompt: With the enthronement ceremony approaching and the Tianji Pavilion's intervention making the situation even more intricate, Chen Ji had to make his choice at the heart of the storm—whether to proactively介入 this power transition, or continue to lurk in the shadows awaiting the right moment?

choices.description: Enter the enthronement ceremony venue as a staff member of the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor, witnessing the Tianji Pavilion's actions firsthand
choices.visible_cost: May directly encounter the Heavenly Dao Eye
choices.visible_reward: First-hand intelligence, may discover the true relationship between the Tianji Pavilion and imperial power
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, will become the target of all parties

text.content: On the day of the enthronement ceremony, Chen Ji changed into ordinary staff attire and slipped into the imperial palace among the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's entourage. The scale of the ceremony far exceeded his imagination—civil and military officials, sect elders, even representatives from the Demonic Path had come to observe. Chen Ji concealed himself among the crowd, yet his eyes searched ceaselessly among the people for traces of the Tianji Pavilion.

However, to his surprise, the Tianji Pavilion did not appear as expected. It was not until the moment the new Emperor offered sacrifices to heaven—when the figure on the dragon throne slowly rose to accept the court officials' bows—that Chen Ji's pupils constricted. He saw the new Emperor's face clearly, and that face...was identical to the Crown Prince who had 'violently died' three years ago! 'Resurrection from the dead? No...' Chen Ji's back grew cold, 'The Tianji Pavilion has been manipulating the succession from the very beginning!'

choices.description: Remain outside the imperial palace to continue surveillance, do not personally take risks, transmit intelligence through hidden agents
choices.visible_reward: Maintain safety, have sufficient time to analyze the situation
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may enter the imperial palace to investigate alone

text.content: Chen Ji did not enter the palace, instead choosing a more稳妥 method—he received real-time updates from the ceremony through the intelligence network arranged via hidden agents. However, the speed of intelligence transmission was far slower than he anticipated, and the content was fragmented, as if someone was deliberately blocking certain information.

Just as he grew anxious and uneasy, an unexpected person appeared—Su Qingyao. Dressed in Inner Disciple robes, her face icy cold, she stood behind Chen Ji, her voice carrying suppressed anger: 'You're indeed here. Chen Ji, I ask you—did you already know what was happening inside the palace?' Her gaze was like a blade, seemingly wanting to pierce through Chen Ji.

choices.text: Lay out the groundwork in advance
choices.description: Using the Foresight Ability, set up traps before the Accession Ceremony and wait for Tianji Pavilion to walk right into the net.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate to conduct multiple Foresights.
choices.visible_reward: Possessing absolute initiative at crucial moments.
choices.risk_hint: The excessive consumption of Heavenly Fate may affect subsequent survival.

text.content: Chen Ji毫不犹豫地启动了天机录的预见能力。一连七次，每次都消耗5点天命值——他几乎是在燃烧自己的命运来换取情报。七次预见，七个可能的未来，最终汇成一条最清晰的脉络：天机阁将在继位大典的最高潮——新帝祭天的那一刻，发动某种仪式。而那个仪式的目的，是将皇权与天道之眼绑定。
「好大的野心……」陈机喃喃道。天机阁想做的不是简单的控制朝堂，而是要将整个皇朝的命运都系于天道之眼。一旦成功，以后每一任皇帝都将成为天道之眼的傀儡，而这人间，也将彻底沦为它的狩猎场。他深吸一口气，在脑海中勾勒出一张反击的大网。
就在各方势力暗流涌动之际，皇宫深处突然传来了沉闷的钟声——那是丧钟。所有人都愣住了，随即反应过来：皇帝，驾崩了。消息如野火般蔓延开来，皇城瞬间陷入了一片混乱。太子太师的脸色铁青，因为他知道，这意味着继位大典必须提前，而他精心布置的一切，都被这突如其来的噩耗打乱了节奏。
陈机站在皇城外的暗处，听着那一声声丧钟，嘴角却浮现出一抹意味深长的笑容。皇帝驾崩……这不在他的预见之中，但却又在他的预料之内。天机阁为了确保计划万无一失，显然选择了最直接的方式——杀死旧帝，让一切按照他们设定的剧本进行。「他们还真是等不及了。」陈机轻声自语，「可惜，你们漏算了一点——我从来不是一个人在下棋。」
远处，新帝继位大典的礼乐已经奏响。皇宫的方向升起了袅袅青烟，那是祭天仪式的信号。而就在那片烟火之中，陈机看到了一个模糊的标志在闪烁——天机阁的标志，比他预见的更早、更清晰地出现在了所有人的视野里。这意味着什么？意味着天机阁已经不再掩饰，他们即将撕下伪装，亮出獠牙。皇朝的风暴，终于来了。
而在这场风暴的中心，陈机忽然感觉到一道熟悉的气息——是凌渊。那个老狐狸不知什么时候也来到了皇宫外围，正用一种充满杀意的目光盯着祭天台的方向。陈机忽然明白了，凌渊也在等待时机。他与凌渊，或许即将迎来真正的对决。但在那之前，他们有一个共同的敌人——天机阁。「敌人的敌人……」陈机低声道，「未必是朋友，但至少，可以利用。」
